title: In secure meetings, officials call another program and it always says 'no'

tellings.quote: then they will say: " Perfectly. Since we are in protected indoors, I will do call to this other one program that has all the knowledge and data about like this, and I'll ask them if at least something matches from what you have, from their achievements." And the answer is always " No".

plain: In secure government meetings, according to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that tries to summon UFOs, officials hear his team's data and then say they will call "this other one program that has all the knowledge and data" to see if anything matches. He tells Michels from his own meetings that "the answer is always 'No'", which, if true, would mean a hidden programme holds data the officials in the room cannot see.
